script_text: Stop! Gemini, Mercury is about to flip your entire November on its head. On November 8, 2026, Mercury forms a tense square to Saturn in your 9th House of belief and legal matters. Avoid signing anything impulsive before sunset, because a hidden detail in the fine print could cost you later. Follow for tomorrow's reading, and comment GEMINI so you do not miss the Mercury shift coming later this week.
